workflows.title: Property activation obligations
workflows.decision: Review changed property bindings, clocks and disable conditions against independent required mode/event obligations and actual activation evidence.
intent_questions: Which independent modes, target events and checking intervals must this property family cover?
Which actual bind population, sampled clock, disable/reset condition and runtime enable establish evaluation at those events?

evidence_roles.meaning: Original independently required behavior, objective or acceptance contract
Actual selected revision, configuration, mode and native tool/model basis
Original native observations and outcomes for the selected engineering question
Source-backed logical-to-native entity and population relationships

revalidate_when: Original requirement, applicability, exclusion rationale or receiving decision changes
Selected native entity, source, configuration, mode, tool/model version or extraction method changes
A dependent relationship or observation premise is changed, missing or contradicted
